import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor"""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return events

        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalysis()

import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor"""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        return events
    
    def process_object_counting(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalysis()
    print("DimuonAnalysis processor ready")
